tools.name: list_shelves
tools.description: Data shelves (default) with price in USD, params, job-tool name and x402 URL. Pass kind=service or kind=all to include owner-fulfilled work. Free to call.

tools.name: buy_shelf
tools.description: Creates a Coinbase checkout for any SKU — use this when no job-named tool exists. Returns x402_url (pay with any x402 client), pay_url (human) and claim_url. Does not move money itself.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Returns the order status. With claim_secret (returned once when the order was opened) the delivery is included once Coinbase reports the payment COMPLETED.

tools.name: get_pass_balance
tools.description: Free. Pass the token from buy_shelf_pass /shelf/shelf-pass-100.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_shelves, check_carrier_authority, check_carrier_basics, check_broker_authority, vet_load, screen_sanctions_name, screen_sanctions_wallet, get_diaspora_metro_snapshot, get_fx_official, get_fx_parallel, get_fx_africa_brief, get_fx_official_all, get_fx_parallel_history_24h, get_fx_parallel_history_7d, localize_text, check_tx_insurance_ce, check_tx_realestate_ce, buy_shelf_pass, prepare_us_nigeria_shipment_handoff · Private data: get_pass_balance, check_carrier_authority, check_broker_authority, screen_sanctions_name, screen_sanctions_wallet, get_diaspora_metro_snapshot, buy_shelf_pass · Public sink: check_carrier_basics, vet_load, prepare_us_nigeria_shipment_handoff · Destructive: localize_text, prepare_us_nigeria_shipment_handoff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_shelves, check_carrier_authority, check_carrier_basics, check_broker_authority, vet_load, screen_sanctions_name, screen_sanctions_wallet, get_diaspora_metro_snapshot, get_fx_official, get_fx_parallel, get_fx_africa_brief, get_fx_official_all, get_fx_parallel_history_24h, get_fx_parallel_history_7d, localize_text, check_tx_insurance_ce, check_tx_realestate_ce, buy_shelf_pass, prepare_us_nigeria_shipment_handoff · Private data: get_pass_balance, check_carrier_authority, check_broker_authority, screen_sanctions_name, screen_sanctions_wallet, get_diaspora_metro_snapshot, buy_shelf_pass · Public sink: check_carrier_basics, vet_load, prepare_us_nigeria_shipment_handoff · Destructive: localize_text, prepare_us_nigeria_shipment_handoff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
